Only after those two scalar operations, 0xf5013d..0xf50153 forwards the payload pointer and payload length preserved from message+0x8/+0x18 into QDataStream::writeRawData at 0x4dd250.

Current-main PR #492 proves the dynamic writer is TIODeviceWriter and its underlying QDataStream is bound to the concrete TGameserverTCPConnection-owned QTcpSocket, so the ordered scalar-before-raw operations belong to the same outbound QTcpSocket-bound serialization path.

The exact RawDataProcessor at 0xb47130 prepends one byte, appends bytes until the QByteArray length is divisible by 8, stores the number of appended bytes in the first byte, and assigns the transformed QByteArray back to the same message.

The deterministic ordered pre-payload scalar fields on the already-proven QTcpSocket-bound writer path are sufficient to classify outbound framing as PROVEN without assigning a semantic name to either scalar.
